preview_performance.performance_status: Representative-voltage analytical scenarios with fixed boost efficiency and cell/wiring resistance loss; no measured charging performance or temperature prediction
preview_performance.higher_power_status: 30-60 W is a same-cell analytical study beyond the current 25 W design target. Higher-power electronics and case fit are not designed. Gain and time are hidden when current at 3.2 V exceeds the cell manufacturer C label; passing this screen does not validate operation.
preview_performance.resistance_basis: Same user-adjustable cell and wiring resistance assumption for each size; not measured cell data
